# EnergyResourceEfficiencyCoOptimization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design methodology that jointly optimizes energy consumption and hardware resource utilization (e.g., area, memory) rather than treating them separately. Addresses the tight power-area budgets of edge devices, guiding architecture choices for both compute-in-memory and neuromorphic systems.
